author: zuckerbastel
quote: If I wanted to play a dating simulator, I'd have bought The Sims. I bought GTA to rob banks, cause mayhem, pick up hookers and generally behave like an absolute bastard, not spend half the game chasing after some **** and dealing with relationship drama. Rockstar have spent ten years developing the most anticipated crime game in history, only to turn it into a glorified dating simulator. Give us GTA, not The Sims with guns.
